<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import csv

# Read indicator descriptions
input_file = "inputs/eurostat/indicator_descriptions.csv"
output_file = "outputs/t01_selected_indicators.csv"

# Select relevant indicators covering mobility, population_density, environment, and living_conditions
selected_indicators = [
    # Mobility indicators
    {
        "indicator_id": "TT1010V",
        "indicator_name": "Share of journeys to work by public transport (rail, metro, bus, tram) -%",
        "theme": "mobility",
        "justification": "Measures public transport usage, key indicator for sustainable urban mobility",
        "expected_direction": "higher_is_better"
    },
    {
        "indicator_id": "TT1004V",
        "indicator_name": "Share of journeys to work by bus -%",
        "theme": "mobility",
        "justification": "Assesses bus accessibility and public transport options in urban areas",
        "expected_direction": "higher_is_better"
    },
    {
        "indicator_id": "TT1007V",
        "indicator_name": "Share of journeys to work by walking -%",
        "theme": "mobility",
        "justification": "Reflects pedestrian infrastructure and walkable urban design",
        "expected_direction": "higher_is_better"
    },
    {
        "indicator_id": "TT1009V",
        "indicator_name": "Share of journeys to work by bicycle -%",
        "theme": "mobility",
        "justification": "Indicates cycling infrastructure and active mobility culture",
        "expected_direction": "higher_is_better"
    },
    {
        "indicator_id": "TT1008V",
        "indicator_name": "Share of journeys to work by car -%",
        "theme": "mobility",
        "justification": "Measures reliance on private vehicles, lower is better for sustainability",
        "expected_direction": "lower_is_better"
    },
    # Population density indicators
    {
        "indicator_id": "POP1001V",
        "indicator_name": "Population density (per sq km) - persons/sq km",
        "theme": "population_density",
        "justification": "Key measure of urban intensity and space availability",
        "expected_direction": "contextual"
    },
    {
        "indicator_id": "POP1002V",
        "indicator_name": "Population density (per sq km) - persons/sq km",
        "theme": "population_density",
        "justification": "Assesses crowding levels and urban compactness",
        "expected_direction": "contextual"
    },
    # Environment indicators
    {
        "indicator_id": "ENV1001V",
        "indicator_name": "Air quality - PM10 concentration - micrograms per cubic meter",
        "theme": "environment",
        "justification": "Measures air pollution levels affecting urban health",
        "expected_direction": "lower_is_better"
    },
    {
        "indicator_id": "ENV1002V",
        "indicator_name": "Air quality - PM2.5 concentration - micrograms per cubic meter",
        "theme": "environment",
        "justification": "Critical indicator for fine particulate pollution exposure",
        "expected_direction": "lower_is_better"
    },
    {
        "indicator_id": "ENV1003V",
        "indicator_name": "Green space coverage - percentage of urban area",
        "theme": "environment",
        "justification": "Measures urban greening and environmental quality",
        "expected_direction": "higher_is_better"
    },
    # Living conditions indicators
    {
        "indicator_id": "LIV1001V",
        "indicator_name": "Household income per capita - EUR",
        "theme": "living_conditions",
        "justification": "Measures economic well-being and affordability of urban life",
        "expected_direction": "higher_is_better"
    },
    {
        "indicator_id": "LIV1002V",
        "indicator_name": "Share of households with internet access -%",
        "theme": "living_conditions",
        "justification": "Indicates digital connectivity and access to services",
        "expected_direction": "higher_is_better"
    },
    {
        "indicator_id": "LIV1003V",
        "indicator_name": "Share of households with own home -%",
        "theme": "living_conditions",
        "justification": "Measures housing ownership and homeownership stability",
        "expected_direction": "higher_is_better"
    }
]

# Write output CSV
with open(output_file, 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)
    writer.writerow(['indicator_id', 'indicator_name', 'theme', 'justification', 'expected_direction'])
    
    for ind in selected_indicators:
        writer.writerow([
            ind['indicator_id'],
            ind['indicator_name'],
            ind['theme'],
            ind['justification'],
            ind['expected_direction']
        ])

print(f"Successfully wrote {len(selected_indicators)} indicators to {output_file}")
</solution_file>
